title: a red ticket is adjudicated against the component's why, the tooth's why and CP1-CP6
intention: CodeMother answers an adjudicate verb: an LLM reads a red ticket's proof and code against the component's why, the tooth's why and CP1-CP6, and records code-wrong or tooth-wrong as an answered question on that ticket.

Siblings, one per piece of outline 9.4.2.3.7, cast together on 2026-11-13: yellow ee4e874a2d61, red tickets 207c4074b3d5, scheduler 185cee7cce24, hourly 810fb2fc4a15, daily cd40ac53f08a, weekly 346c75c2f8b7, Cairn's list c811a8b1b8c7, adjudication aa2d42b15886. traces_to: outline 9.4.2.3.7.6 and 17.11.6/17.11.6.1 (adjudicated by CC against the sieve's own why, never a question to Akien); CP1-CP6; Law 8
how: adjudicate.py in codemother gathers the component charter's why, the tooth's why (the proof's docstring and PROVES text), core-values.md and the run record; asks inferenceproxy over the bus; opens a question on the red ticket and answers it with --measured, so a tooth change can cite the answer as its decision.

clauses.claim: adjudicate on a red ticket opens one question bound to it and answers it with exactly one of code-wrong or tooth-wrong, the reasons naming a why or a CP
an inference answer that is neither outcome is refused loudly and no answer is written
a reseal of a proof whose teeth changed passes rung 4 citing that answered question's id

decisions.text: D1: ORDER. Builds after 207c4074b3d5: the red tickets are what it reads.

D2: VERB `adjudicate`, body {ticket}. It reads the ticket's `fixes` key, the proof file, the owning charter's why, CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/core-values.md and the run record named in `measured`; asks inferenceproxy over the bus (the pattern in cairn/devices/codemother/digest.py) for exactly one of code-wrong | tooth-wrong, each with its reasons naming the why or CP it rests on. No third outcome (17.11.6).

D3: RECORD. The verdict lands as `cairn question open --ticket <id>` then `cairn question answer <q> <verdict and reasons> --spawned none --measured`; its id is what a tooth change cites as its decision: the reseal door's rung 4 already accepts a question id (reseal.ruling_refusal(question_root=...)) and corrosion's constraint_enforcement_holds reads an answered question in the same act.

D4: CALLER. The tester's red_tickets (207c4074b3d5) asks `adjudicate` over the bus after each cast; that one ask is written by this ticket, because the ask is the caller's side of this verb's contract.
D5: PROOF, red-first, with a stub inference answer over the scratch bus.

measured.saw: no adjudication of proof reds exists; 17.11.6 adjudication of sieve refusals is ticketed under 39eccfbc09aa (every sieve carries its own why); rung 4 refusal reads a question root
measured.how: grep for 17.11.6 over CairnCommons/tickets; read of cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py:229 and :451
